# openssl — 2004 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 5 openssl CVEs of 2004 are in `data/cve/vendors/openssl/2004.jsonl`.

### CVE-2004-0079
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-03-18 | Updated: 2025-01-16 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: n/a; CWE-476 CWE-476 NULL Pointer Dereference
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

The do_change_cipher_spec function in OpenSSL 0.9.6c to 0.9.6k, and 0.9.7a to 0.9.7c, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via a crafted SSL/TLS handshake that triggers a null dereference.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
